name: K-Bomv Ramen
ingredients_raw: Noodles: Refined Wheat Flour, Edible Vegetable Oil (Rice Bran Oil), Iodized Salt, Wheat Gluten, Starch, Gelling Agent (INS 508), Sequestrant (INS 451(i)), Thickener (INS 412), Acidity Regulators (INS 501(i), INS 500(i)). Seasoning Mix: Iodized Salt, Sugar, Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Maltodextrin, *Spices and Condiments (Contains Garlic, Chilli), Acidity Regulator (INS 330, INS 296), Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein, Fermented Soya Sauce Powder, Flavour Enhancers (INS 627, INS 631), Milk Solids, Lemon Powder (1.2%), Anticaking Agent (INS 551) and Colour (INS 150d), Antioxidant (INS 319). *Used as natural flavouring agent. Garnish: Spices and Condiments (Chilli), Sugar, Iodized Salt, Dehydrated Herb (Chives). Allergen statement: Contains wheat, milk, soya and sulphite.
